_about: The economy audit (tools/audit.sh, the Economy audit workflow): what every play-bot run (tools/balance_sim) is checked against, so a broken economy fails the audit instead of being a figure to read (owner, 19-20 Nov: 'nothing should get missed by the audit bot'). Each target names a metric the bot measures (BalanceSim.metrics, or the first hour's), and `most` or `least`; `min_days` the shortest run it applies to; `styles` the bot styles that play that part of the game; `first_hour` for the first-hour run. `why` is the gap that put it here. A target is changed only with the owner's say: it is the game's promise, not the bot's.

targets.why: coins sat idle on 57 to 82% of days (19 Nov): the late game was too easy

always something worth working toward in the Market (Part 4: costing 1 to 3 visits of income; a casual player's one visit is a day's income, so most things cost less than one and are bought the day they show)
repairs were under 1% of earnings (19 Nov): more utilities must mean more upkeep (measured over the run's last third, when wear has built up)
upkeep must not eat the farm
a farm unable to plant (no coins, nothing growing) is a dead end: the casual start (19 Nov)
a week away never loses an animal, tree or building (Part 4)
strays came every 3 to 6 hours (19 Nov): at most 3 a week
a playing farm is level 3 on its first day
a casual farm sat at level 2 until day 4 (19 Nov)
the climb must not race: levels are earned
the rare coop project could never finish (19 Nov)

a crafting building pays back in about a week of crafting (Part 4); the Bakery took 370 to 460 days (20 Nov): recipes wait on bushels and animal goods the farm rarely has. Owner left the call to Claude (20 Nov): 18 days, for a harder game; two slots at 1 star, bushels 30% a harvest, goods at twice their ingredients give 16 (more bushels did not help: three visits a day are the limit)
a free player earns a few gems a week (Part 4)

52 of the first 60 minutes had goals open and nothing to do, and the first session ended with 9 coins (19 Nov); waiting on growing crops is FarmVille, a minute with nothing growing either is a dead end (coins spent on crops are not: the coins-at-10-minutes target was dropped, 20 Nov, as every coin was in the ground)
level 3 in the first quarter hour
